events.preview_text: Jimmy provides a flexible steel blade for a prying step.
events.body:
When a repair calls for prying after the screws are out, reach for a tool designed for that step. The iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit includes **Jimmy**, so you have a dedicated prying tool within the kit.

Jimmy pairs a flexible steel blade with an ergonomic handle for precise, powerful prying. That combination gives the blade a clear purpose beyond what a precision driver can do.

It also makes one of the kit’s less familiar opening tools easier to assess: Jimmy is not another bit. It is designed for repair steps that call for prying with a steel blade.

When a repair step calls for prying, a precision driver has finished its part. The next move may require a thin blade made for that task.

The iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit includes Jimmy, a prying tool with a flexible steel blade and an ergonomic handle. That pairing is designed for precise, powerful prying when the repair calls for it.

This is what an additional opening tool can provide beyond removing fasteners: a specific tool for a specific kind of access work. That does not mean Jimmy suits every device or opening step.

On the product page, you can see Jimmy among the included tools and access iFixit’s care-and-use guide for details about the kit’s components. Use that information to decide whether purpose-built prying tools belong in your first general repair toolkit.

A first general repair toolkit has an upfront cost. What happens if one of its tools later breaks is another part of that purchase decision.

The iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit is a general electronics repair toolkit listed at **$79.95**. It carries a **lifetime guarantee**, and iFixit states that it will replace an iFixit tool if it breaks.

That replacement commitment is the longer-term support to weigh against the price. Its scope stays specific to an iFixit tool that breaks.

The product page lets you confirm the current price and review the toolkit’s stated lifetime guarantee before deciding whether that commitment justifies the cost for you.
